title: The Complete Symmetry Algebra of the Gardner Equation and Wei-Norman Solution Methods: From Infinite-Dimensional Operator Structures to Practical Solution Algorithms
content: We present a comprehensive analysis of the operator algebra underlying the Gardner equation, Au - 6(qB + C)u + Du = 0, where A = ∂/∂t, B = u²∂/∂x, C = u∂/∂x, and D = ∂³/∂x³. Through systematic computation of commutator algebras, we demonstrate that while the discrete operator set exhibits infinite-dimensional growth with polynomial scaling, the complete symmetry structure can be elegantly represented using precisely fifteen exponential operator families. Building upon this foundation, we develop a modified Wei-Norman solution method that transforms the Gardner equation into a finite 15-dimensional nonlinear ODE system, providing practical solution algorithms for any parameter value q. This approach bridges abstract infinite-dimensional Lie algebra theory with computational solution methods, offering new insights into integrable systems and practical tools for applications in hydrodynamics, plasma physics, and quantum field theory.
